_comment: Optional one-liner per ticker: why it's a great investment or not. Add symbols as needed. Script falls back to horizon_special 'special' or auto-generated from scores.
NVDA: AI capex cycle leader; high volatility, strong long-term theme.
AAPL: Quality compounder; services growth and capital return.
TSLA: EV adoption play; margins and competition pressure.
SPY: Core equity exposure; low-cost S&P 500 building block.
BTC-USD: Digital store of value; macro and risk-on sentiment.
NEAR-USD: Sharded L1; developer UX; AI/agent narrative.
TAO-USD: Decentralized machine learning subnet marketplace; high beta.
HG=F: Copper: electrification and grid demand; cyclical.
GC=F: Gold: inflation hedge and real rates sensitivity.
SI/GC: Silver/Gold ratio (SI=F ÷ GC=F); relative precious-metal value.
FCX: Copper and gold miner; leverage to commodity cycle.
JPM: Quality bank; rates and buyback beneficiary.
CLOV: Medicare Advantage / Clover Assistant; health-tech underwriting focus; growth vs medical cost risk.
ALAB: Astera Labs — AI connectivity / PCIe-CXL retimers and Aries/Leo; data-center scale-out.
CRDO: Credo — high-speed SerDes / Active Electrical Cables for AI cluster interconnect.
VRT: Vertiv — data-center power, cooling, and thermal management infrastructure.
AACAY: AAC Technologies — MEMS / acoustics / sensors for phones, wearables, and AI devices.
TER: Teradyne — semiconductor test equipment; AI chip production bottleneck beneficiary.
MKSI: MKS Instruments — process control / vacuum / lasers for chip and specialty manufacturing.
MU: Micron — HBM and DRAM for AI accelerators; memory cycle + AI capacity.
TOELY: Tokyo Electron — wafer fab equipment (coater/developer, etch, deposition).
AMAT: Applied Materials — wafer fab equipment; broad AI semiconductor capex exposure.
ASML: ASML — EUV lithography monopoly; critical for advanced logic/memory nodes.
LITE: Lumentum — optical / photonic components for AI data-center interconnect and lasers.
COHR: Coherent — lasers, optics, and materials for AI networking and industrial photonics.
GLW: Corning — optical fiber, glass, and specialty materials for AI/data-center and display.
000660.KS: SK Hynix — HBM and DRAM; key AI memory supplier alongside Micron/Samsung.
HQ: Horizon Quantum — quantum software tools and Triple Alpha IDE; early-stage quantum software.
ZETA: Zeta Global — AI marketing / CDP platform; identity graph and enterprise customer acquisition.
IREN: IREN — Bitcoin mining + AI/HPC data centers; power and capacity expansion story.
HIVE: HIVE Digital — BTC mining / HPC; Canada/Sweden operations; crypto and AI compute mix.
RIOT: Riot Platforms — US Bitcoin miner; hash rate and energy strategy; high BTC beta.
KILO.TO: Purpose Gold Bullion Fund (TSX) — physical gold exposure; precious-metal holding.
NOW: ServiceNow — enterprise workflow / ITSM SaaS platform; AI agents and platform expansion.
META: Ad and AI; engagement and monetization strength.
AMZN: E-commerce and cloud; margin expansion story.
GOOGL: Search and cloud; AI and capital return.
MSFT: Cloud and AI; durable growth and margin.
AMD: Data center and PC; competitive vs NVDA.
NFG: Gold explorer (Quebec); high-grade discovery leverage; pre-production.
NFG.V: Gold explorer (Quebec); Queensway project; high-grade discovery leverage; pre-production.
VNQ: Broad real estate; income and diversification.
